english.title: Smoke in smoke-free premises - Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) smoked in smoke-free premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(a) and (6) of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Smoke-free places include workplaces (section 7 of the Public Health (Wales) Act 2017), premises that are open to the public (section 8), outdoor care settings for children (section 9), school grounds (section 10), hospital grounds (section 11), public playgrounds (section 12) and additional smoke-free premises under regulations under section 13 of the Act.
(ii) For a defence where the person did not know, and could not reasonably have been expected to know, that the premises were smoke-free premises, see section 5(4) and (5).
(iii) The fixed penalty amount is £100 (regulation 20(b) of the Smoke-free Premises and Vehicles (Wales) Regulations 2020); the discounted amount £75 (regulation 21(b)). For the form of the fixed penalty notice, see regulation 22.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant smoked in smoke-free premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..).
